sample_unit: radiology studies (CT and MRI) interpreted by a single radiologist

links.outcome: Inter-study interval time by modality, comparing baseline vs LLM-assisted periods
links.effect: Reductions for outpatient CT with contrast (23.0 vs 13.0 min; p=0.0021) and without contrast (18.5 vs 7.0 min; p=0.0017); no improvement for MRI with contrast (14.0 vs 16.0; p=0.2808) or without contrast (14.0 vs 7.0; p=0.0889).
links.quote: LLM assistance significantly reduced inter-study intervals for outpatient CT with contrast (23.0 vs 13.0 minutes; difference 10 minutes; p = 0.0021) and without contrast (18.5 vs 7.0 minutes; difference 11.5 minutes; p = 0.0017).

unlisted_practices: Disease-specific report templates in a custom GPT for radiology reporting
Assessing task-technology fit using the UTAUT framework to guide LLM adoption

screen.reason: Empirical cohort study assessing the real-world deployment of a custom LLM (ChatGPT Enterprise) into a radiologist's clinical reporting workflow to measure efficiency and adoption using the UTAUT framework.
